resources.string: This is the Dunwood Loc File! Always add the RV in the rightmost column: Territory_Dunwood or Raid_MonarchsBluffs_00 as applicable

string.direction: Solemn for first sentence. Second sentence, full of remorse
string.context: Triggered by players as they interact with Myrddin's memory shards on the raid docks. It contains a record of Myrddin's memories and provides short narrative context.
string.speaker: Myrddin's Memories
string.name: WizardMyrddin

resources.string: May this memory fragment guide those who are worthy. May you undo the harm I once caused Ys…

string.context: Triggered by players as they interact with Myrddin's memory shards before the Twin Jester boss fight. It contains a record of Myrddin's memories and provides short narrative context.
string.speaker: Myrddin's Memories
string.name: WizardMyrddin

resources.string: These shards will be able to unlock the path forward... But be warned, the relic I have attempted to seal on Ys is powerful and its nefarious influence... contagious.

string.context: Triggered by players as they interact with Myrddin's memory shards before the Queen Dahut boss fight. It contains a record of Myrddin's memories and provides short narrative context.
string.speaker: Myrddin's Memories
string.name: WizardMyrddin

resources.string: Princess Dahut and her guards will prove instrumental in protecting the Spear of Longinus. I can only hope nothing detracts them from their duty towards Ys and they do not succumb to the relic's influence…

string.context: Triggered by players as they interact with Myrddin's memory shards at the bottom of Thorpe's tower. It contains a record of Myrddin's memories and provides short narrative context.
string.speaker: Myrddin's Memories
string.name: WizardMyrddin

resources.string: Gradlon and I agreed the spear should be kept as far from the rest of the island as possible. The path will be sealed to all but the ruler of Ys... but with this shard, a worthy soul will be able to bypass this restriction should the need arise.

string.direction: Lost entity, Aggressive. Groaning/undead voice, Disembodied.
string.context: Automatically played as one of the players get near to the level trigger. The spirit of Gradlon, the last King of Ys, aggressively greets players as they first start the raid. He is completely under Thorpe's control and tries to chase away anyone who could threaten his master's plans.
string.speaker: Ominous Voice
string.name: KingGradlon

string.direction: Lost entity, Aggressive. Groaning/undead voice, Disembodied. Ends on a lamenting wail (like a ghost in the mist).
string.context: Same as above, players have progressed halfway through the first chapter of the raid and Gradlon attempts to chase them away again.
string.speaker: Ominous Voice
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: You are not welcome here... LEAVE!

string.direction: The first part, before the "-", is calm and regal. "heroes who - Intruders!": his speech is interrupted on the "-", as if possessed, as he becomes restless and threatens the players.
string.context: Gradlon regains his spirit momentarily after players defeat the first boss, briefly reminisces a piece of lore and attempts to congratulates the players before falling back under Thorpe's control
string.speaker: King Gradlon
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: At last, the Jester has fallen! His banishment from the court was too light a punishment, but death befits him well! Praise the heroes who - INTRUDERS! Your presence soils this land, BEGONE!

string.direction: The first portion is remorseful as Gradlon reminisces his daughter. He becomes cold and hostile on "VERMIN", threatening the players. Becoming almost feral at the end.
string.context: Immediately after players defeat the second boss of the raid and Gradlon's daughter, Princess Dahut. Gradlon once again briefly escapes Thorpe's control and is torn between relief that his daughter's soul has been freed from Thorpe's clutches but also saddened by her passing. He then falls back under Thorpe's control and becomes aggressive once again.
string.speaker: King Gradlon
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: My dear daughter Dahut... may your soul finally find peace, freed from the tyrant's clutches... VERMIN! Your bodies will be broken and your souls scourged!

string.direction: Regaining his lucidity and purpose, he directs the raid to defeat Thorpe.
string.context: As players near the final tower of the raid, where Thorpe awaits them. Gradlon has seemingly escaped Thorpe's control. He warns players that Thorpe's plans are almost complete and they must hurry to stop him.
string.speaker: King Gradlon
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: Brave warriors, the tyrant's grip loosens and my mind is mine once more... but my Mist has weakened and Myrddin's magic wanes... The spear will not elude him much longer. You MUST stop him, or all is doomed

string.direction: Weakened, hurried. Gradlon sounds almost desperate.
string.context: Gradlon's final plea to the players to take down Thorpe before the final face-off
string.speaker: King Gradlon
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: Myrddin's spell is almost broken, and with it my consciousness fades... Hurry! I beg you!

string.context: The Ys Jester, the first boss of the raid, awaits players at the very beginning of the level, perched on a stone arch (cannot be damaged at this point). He delivers a short taunt before vanishing away as players are ambushed by a wave of Lost creatures.
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: Finally, a new audience! Welcome to my opening act!

string.direction: Sounds like an announcer talking to a public, takes a more sinister and threatening voice to say "the vanquished"
string.context: Intro VO for the Jester when players trigger the fight (plays at the beginning of every attempt)
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: WELCOME to my spectacle! Your role today? The vanquished.

string.context: Plays before the Spot the difference mechanic, where the Jester vanishes and creates clones of himself. Players must find the clone that is identical to the Jester and destroy it before the end of a set timer to counter the mechanic
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: It's all but smoke and mirrors!

string.context: Plays when players fail to successfully handle the "Spot the Difference" mechanic
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.context: Plays at the beginning of the Gone in Smoke attack: the Jester vanishes and reppears next to a random player and instantly delivers a melee attack
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.context: Played whenever the Jester enters his Interlude behavior: he first siphons health from all adds in the vicinity before telporting to another section of the arena
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.context: Plays once the Jester teleports away and starts to channel his Interlude attack: players must find the real jester in the arena and interrupt him before the end of the channeling
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.direction: sounds angry, like the player broke a rule
string.context: Plays whenever the Jester is dragged "out of bound" within the village where the fight takes place. He will then teleport to a random player or enter his interlude behavior to return to a valid section of the village
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: No, no, no, NO running away!

string.context: Plays when the jester reaches the correct HP threshold to trigger Phase 2 of his encounter
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: Let's move on to the next Act!

string.direction: Sounds like an announcer talking to a public
string.context: A massive AOE attack where the jester surrounds the section of the arena he is currently in with a ring-shaped wall of flame
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: Perfect for a public in the round!

string.context: Plays at the beginning of an attack where the jester spawns multiple "Jack in the Boxes" that behave as mines
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: Can you think outside the box?

string.direction: Sounds like an announcer talking to a public
string.context: Plays when the jester reaches the correct HP threshold to trigger Phase 3 of his encounter
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.context: Starts playing at the start (during preparation) of the Jester's Fiery Cackle attack, where he spawns fiery projectile in a star pattern around him.
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: I'm BLAZING A TRAIL in buffoonery!

string.context: Plays when the jester reaches the correct HP threshold to trigger Phase 4 (final phase) of his encounter, where he is scripted to play his Grand Finale mechanic (a dps check where players must finish the Jester before he can fire off his ultimate, guaranteed wipe attack)
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.direction: Sounds like an announcer talking to a public, with a condescending tone
string.context: Plays whenever players fail the encounter (all players dead or downed)
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: A mediocre audience makes for a mediocre spectacle…

string.context: Plays during the Jester's death animation, once players have defeated him
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

resources.string: THIS... is how I make my exit?

string.direction: Short, quick inhale, minimal physical effort. Quick breath in before attack
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.direction: Light grunt or exhale out on attack motion.
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.direction: Reactions to being hit, falling, or taking damage
string.context: Get 10 different selects for variety, 5 Medium effort and 5 Large effort
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.direction: Heavy grunt or exhale out on attack motion. major physical effort
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.direction: Deeper, longer inhale, preparing significant effort.
string.speaker: Twin Jesters
string.name: TwinJesters

string.context: Fight intro, Dahut is standing above the arena and looking down on players and the kneeling Palatines. As her VO ends, the Palatines raise up from their kneeling position and start the fight.
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

resources.string: Upon my duty to my Father and my new Lord, your little incursion shall end here and now…

string.direction: Still solemn. Still queenly. Hides her true face until the very last phase.
string.context: Phase transition once players have taken all 4 Palatine Guards down to 50% HP
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

resources.string: A commendable effort, but enough games. My knights... Remove them.

string.context: Phase transition once players have killed all 4 Palatine Guards for the first time
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

resources.string: Enough! Your pesky squirming will only make this more... brutal.

string.direction: Commanding, serious, more intense than before.
string.context: Plays shortly after the phase transition just above. Dahut strikes a pose and channels energy for a few seconds in order to raise the Palatine Guards from the dead.
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

resources.string: Now rise, my knights... and fulfill your duty!

string.direction: A thin veil of cold inflexibility hiding increasing desperation.
string.context: Similar to line above, will play whenever Dahut attempts to raise Palatine Guards that players have killed during phase 3.
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

resources.string: As many times as it takes…

string.direction: In phase 3, Dahut's voice lines are more aggressive to fit her battle-hungry disposition.
string.context: Plays when Dahut triggers her Mystic Disruption attack, a magic attack that lasts for ~5seconds.
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

string.direction: A tinge of aggressiveness hidden behind a veil of total control.
string.context: Plays when Dahut is dashing from player to player during her Dance of Death attack. She targets every player that has an Abyss Mark one by one, dashing to them at high speed and delivering two heavy-hitting melee attacks before zipping away to the next player
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

string.direction: A tinge of aggressiveness hidden behind a veil of total control.
string.context: Plays when Dahut is dashing from player to player during her Dance of Death attack. She targets every player that has an Abyss Mark one by one, dashing to them at high speed and delivering two heavy-hitting melee attacks before zipping away to the next player
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

string.direction: A tinge of aggressiveness hidden behind a veil of total control.
string.context: Plays when Dahut is dashing from player to player during her Dance of Death attack. She targets every player that has an Abyss Mark one by one, dashing to them at high speed and delivering two heavy-hitting melee attacks before zipping away to the next player
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

string.direction: Dahut's voice is twisted by anger and the strain to unleash her most powerful spell.
string.context: Plays for the finisher portion of Dance of Death: Dahut targets the alst player in the group with an Abyss Mark and casts a magic attack on them, raining down energy daggers from a portal that opens up above the player.
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

string.direction: Dahut dismisses the players. A front of haughtiness and content, but a tinge of lament can be found in her tone
string.context: Plays when all players are dead or in death-door during the encounter, just before it resets.
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

resources.string: A shame... you were weaker than I had hoped.

string.context: Plays at the start of Dahut's death aimation, marking the end of the fight and the players' victory
string.speaker: Queen Dahut
string.name: QueenDahut

string.name: QueenDahut

string.context: Plays at the beginning of the fight (every attempt), as Thorpe turns around to face the player group
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Who dares? You? How much longer do you intend to stand in my way? But I am in control of my own fate now and I shall have my revenge against Aeternum... and you!

string.context: Plays during the channeling portion or the Relic Recall/Relic channel mechanic. thorpe is channeling the Spear of Longinus and drawing it to him. If he is allowed to grab it, he will transition into the Relic Channel animation/ability
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Come to me, Spear of Longinus! I am your rightful master!

string.context: Follow-up ability for Relic Recall when Thorpe is allowed to grab the relic. He briefly channels energy, raises up into the air and triggers a magic attack where spears of light come crashing down on all players in the fight. This attack becomes a guaranteed wipe if Thorpe is allowed to play it more than twice during the fight
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: This is but a taste of my rancour!

string.context: Played on the third occurrence of Relic Channel, which guarantees all remaining players will die and the encounter will reset
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Finally! How sweet is the taste of revenge!

string.context: Plays when players successfully catch the relic and prevent Thorpe from grabbing it during relic Recall.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: No! This power is mine alone!

string.context: Plays when Thorpe activates Mist Extension, covering his sword in Mist and gaining a massive damage and melee range increase
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: No longer shall I stand your presence!

string.context: Plays when Thorpe uses his FlyOverhead attack, jumping to a distant player and delivering an overhead slash attack
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.context: Plays when Thorpe transitions from phase 1 to phase 2 at 80% Health and activates the first 2 Boss Souls in the fight.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: You will pay for this! Arise, souls of the dead!

string.direction: Arrogant, forceful Thorpe is addressing the souls of the previous raid bosses
string.context: Plays when Thorpe enters the Unholy Smite mechanic. he will run to the center of the arena and fire a Flame Wips towards all activated Boss Souls. Players must intercept these in order to prevent the Boss Souls from detonating and dealing massive damage in a large area
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: You exist only to serve me!

string.context: Plays when Thorpe slams down on the ground, firing a wave of energy towards random boss Souls and causing them to summon their respective Shadow Clones.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.direction: Angry and menacing Should feel like a build up from Phase2 Start VO
string.context: Plays when Thorpe transitions from phase 2 to phase 3 at 60% Health and activates the 3rd and 4th Boss Souls in the fight.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Argh, enough! I will enjoy torturing your souls!

string.direction: Arrogant and concentrated/a bit weary (he's channeling power) Thorpe is addressing the souls of the previous raid bosses
string.context: Plays when Thorpe triggers Soul Dominion. he channels all valid Boss Souls for about 10 seconds during which players must destroy them all to interrupt Thorpe. Failure to do so will cause all remaining active Boss Souls to fire off waves of projectiles in a bullet-hell pattern for multiple seconds.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.context: One of Thorpe's attacks, where he targets all live players in the encounter with a spell that follows its target and erupts in a puddle of arcane energy for several seconds after a delay.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: I will burn it ALL if I have to!

string.context: Thorpe targets a player with a projectile attack. if successful (players is hit by the attack), Thorpe will dash to them and deliver a powerful follow-up attack.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.direction: Angry and in denial, hints of nervousness/despair building up. Should feel like a build-up from phase 2>3 transition
string.context: Plays when Thorpe transitions from phase 3 to phase 4 at 20% Health and activates the 5th and 6th Boss Souls in the fight.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: What? No! Not this time! I will sunder your souls!

string.context: Plays during Thorpe's Hunger of the Void attack. Thorpe strikes a poses with his sword raised in the air and channels 4 rotating arcane beams that rotate and cover the entire arena for multiple seconds.
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: I will enjoy watching you burn! I am... Almighty!

string.context: Plays when Thorpe defeats all players, before wiping them and resetting the encounter
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Your suffering will not end with your death!

string.direction: Short, quick inhale, minimal physical effort. Quick breath in before attack
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe

string.direction: Reactions to being hit, falling, or taking damage

string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.context: Thorpe's first line during the end raid in-game cutscene
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Is this to be my eternal torment, forever falling before you?

string.context: Thorpe's second line during the end raid in-game cutscene
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Very well... I have grown weary of this vain struggle…

string.context: Thorpe's first line during the end raid in-game cutscene
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: All shall know the name of Thorpe.

string.context: Thorpe's second line during the end raid in-game cutscene
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: Cowardly ghost, the spear is mine!

string.context: Thorpe's third line during the end raid in-game cutscene
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

resources.string: So this... is my fate? At… your hand?

string.direction: stoic, accepting his end and true death
string.context: Thorpe's fourth and final line during the end raid in-game cutscene
string.speaker: Overlord Thorpe
string.name: CaptainThorpe

string.context: King Gradlon's first line during the end raid in-game cutscene, once Thorpe has vanished
string.speaker: King Gradlon
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: Fortune has granted me a successor!

string.context: King Gradlon's second line during the end raid in-game cutscene, once Thorpe has vanished
string.speaker: King Gradlon
string.name: KingGradlon

resources.string: To you I bestow the Spear of Longinus. Heed its power.
